CREATE TABLE dbo.stg_customer_cleaned
(
    customer_id VARCHAR(50),
    first_name VARCHAR(100),
    last_name VARCHAR(100),
    email VARCHAR(255),
    phone VARCHAR(30),
    age INT,
    gender VARCHAR(20),
    city VARCHAR(100),
    state VARCHAR(100),
    country VARCHAR(100),
    signup_date DATE,
    customer_segment VARCHAR(50),
    annual_income DECIMAL(18,2),
    total_spend DECIMAL(18,2),
    total_orders INT,
    is_active BIT
);




SELECT TOP 10 *
FROM dbo.stg_customer_cleaned;



SELECT
    customer_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    email,
    age,
    annual_income,
    total_spend,
    total_orders,
    is_active
FROM dbo.stg_customer_cleaned
WHERE age IS NULL
   OR annual_income IS NULL
   OR total_spend IS NULL
   OR total_orders IS NULL
   OR is_active IS NULL;
